quarterly_data.quarter: Lite-On press release: LITEON Technology Reports Consolidated August Sales of (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: August 2026 consolidated revenue NT$19.6 billion, up 3% M-o-M and 25% Y-o-Y; January-August cumulative sales NT$134.7 billion, up 27% Y-o-Y. The company attributes the growth mainly to high-end server power systems for cloud and AI applications, high-efficiency backup battery units (BBU) and opto-electronic semiconductors. Segment mix: Cloud & AIoT 60% of sales, with yearly growth over 40% on delivery growth of power management systems for high-end datacenter servers and cloud computing; Opto-electronics 14% of sales, nearly 20% Y-o-Y growth (photocouplers for industrial automation, new energy and AI power; infrared and visible LED indicators for AI servers and switches); Information Technology & Consumer Electronics 26% of sales, up 5% M-o-M on steady shipment growth of LEO satellite power systems and advanced power supplies.
